items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: I'm down the highway with Ray Charles an' Charles Brown...the Clovers...

ctx.x: Well, anyway, gettin' back to this Creole business. The fellow that run the place was named Frank Peffe [pronounces the name "Pen-yay"]. He had about four...five brothers, and they all worked in the place, an' we had a good time. We had...I used to go down there a beautiful time o' year. Ever' time I'd leave an' go away, they'd call me back...'cause we'd pack the place.
An' so I left outa New Orleans and went back down in Texas. So I played some one-nighters. I'm down the highway with Ray Charles an' Charles Brown...the Clovers...
Was Pete Johnson still with you when you were doin' this?
